Attribute.Name: Does the record have a Primary Product Image assigned?
Attribute.ValueTemplate:
<derive expr="{
    primaryAssetCurrent:=references('', 'PMDM.IDRT.PrimaryProductImage'),
    goldenRecord:=iterate(
        referencesto('Product', 'PMDM.PRT.GoldenToSourceRecord'),
        'referenceowner()'
    ),
    primaryAssetGolden:=iterate(goldenRecord, 'references("", "PMDM.IDRT.PrimaryProductImage")')
}
if(
    listlen(primaryAssetCurrent)>0,
    iterate(stepurl2objid(stepurl("entity", "SysMsg_RecordHasAlreadyPrimaryImage")), "value('PMDM.AT.SystemMessage')"),
    if(
        listlen(primaryAssetGolden)>0,
        iterate(stepurl2objid(stepurl("entity", "SysMsg_GRHasPrimaryImage")), "value('PMDM.AT.SystemMessage')"),
        iterate(stepurl2objid(stepurl("entity", "SysMsg_RecordDoesntHavePrimaryImage")), "value('PMDM.AT.SystemMessage')")
    )
)"/>
